title: When the Border Sings
premise: Ada Amberdale, a ghost investigator who launders the reputations of banks by burying their dirtiest cases, receives a calendar invite from Marcus Vane, her handler who died six months ago, scheduling a meeting in Frankfurt before markets open. Following Vane's digital breadcrumbs, Ada uncovers a laundering pipeline called Meridian that runs through the very firm that erased her own identity years ago, and learns Vane faked his death to leave behind proof of it. Hunted by the firm's fixer and betrayed by her only ally, Ada must choose between publishing the ledger that will destroy her last shred of anonymity and trading it back for a clean escape. In the end she broadcasts the ledger from the Frankfurt exchange floor at opening bell, sacrificing her invisibility but finally owning her name.
about_author: Noor Galloway is the pen name of a former compliance analyst who spent a decade tracing money across European borders before turning to fiction. They write thrillers about people whose jobs require them to not exist.

chapters.title: The Invitation
chapters.summary: POV: Ada. Ada scrubs another bank's scandal into oblivion, then finds a meeting request from Marcus Vane, dead half a year, set for tomorrow, 8:45 a.m., Frankfurt. The attachment is a single word: Meridian. Emotional beat: unease curdling into compulsion; the invisible woman being seen.

chapters.title: Clean Money
chapters.summary: POV: Ada. Flashback-tinged chapter as Ada prepares to run: she wipes her apartment, burns her go-bag protocol, and reflects on how she became a person with no attributable past. A tail she can't confirm follows her to the airport. Emotional beat: grief and paranoia braided together.

chapters.title: Dead Drop Protocol
chapters.summary: POV: Ada. In Frankfurt, following Vane's steganographic trail through a private banking archive, Ada retrieves a hidden drive and meets Ilse Brandt, Vane's former colleague who claims he trusted no one but Ada. First glimpse of Meridian's scale. Emotional beat: cautious alliance, first flicker of hope.

chapters.title: The Fixer
chapters.summary: POV: alternating Ada and Anton Reiss, the firm's fixer. Reiss is dispatched to make the invitation problem disappear; his cold professionalism contrasts Ada's scrambling humanity. Ada realizes the meeting invite was bait meant to flush her out. Emotional beat: dread; the hunter's calm versus the hunted's panic.

chapters.title: Meridian Rising
chapters.summary: POV: Ada. Decrypted files reveal Meridian: a pipeline moving cartel and oligarch money through shell foundations, including one tied to the firm that erased Ada's original identity. Her personal history is entangled with the case. Emotional beat: vertigo as the professional becomes personal.

chapters.title: What Vane Left Behind
chapters.summary: POV: Ada. A video message from Vane explains he faked his death when the firm ordered him to bury Meridian; the ledger on the drive is complete but broadcasting it requires access codes held inside the exchange. He apologizes for using her. Emotional beat: betrayal and tenderness at once; loyalty to a dead man tested against truth.

chapters.title: Ilse
chapters.summary: POV: Ada. Ilse offers Ada an out: trade the ledger to the firm's rivals for new identities for them both. Ada discovers Ilse has been feeding Reiss their locations all along. Escape through the banking district at night. Emotional beat: the sting of misplaced trust; loyalty vs. truth made flesh.

chapters.title: Eight Hours
chapters.summary: POV: alternating Ada and Reiss. Countdown structure: Ada plans to reach the exchange floor before opening bell while Reiss closes the net, taking hostages among her old contacts. Ada must decide whether the secret is worth more than her survival. Emotional beat: rising pressure, ticking-clock terror, grim resolve.

chapters.title: Opening Bell
chapters.summary: POV: Ada. Climax. Ada infiltrates the exchange during pre-market chaos, confronts Reiss on the visitor gallery, and uploads the ledger as the bell rings, streaming Meridian to every regulator and newsroom at once. Reiss is taken down mid-stride. Emotional beat: catharsis; choosing truth over safety in a single irreversible act.

chapters.title: A Name of Her Own
chapters.summary: POV: Ada. Aftermath: markets reel, arrests begin, and Ada, now publicly named and investigated herself, gives a statement under her real name for the first time in years. She visits Vane's unmarked grave. Emotional beat: quiet resolution; visibility as both cost and freedom, identity reclaimed.
